data.name: All Possible Suspects
data.detailed_description:
Step into frozen moments in time and piece together the truth. All Possible Suspects is a point-and-click deduction game of observation and logic, where you must analyze intricate, static scenes to reconstruct a series of diverse and unusual occurrences.

All the keywords you need are already provided. Your task is to use reason, observation, and logical deduction to arrange them correctly and solve the mystery.

How It Works

Every scenario is a logic puzzle captured in a single, motionless instant.
  • Observe the Scene: Look closely at characters, items, and the environment to understand the context of what just happened.
  • Analyze the Clues: Gather information from the frozen moment to figure out the relationships, motives, and sequence of events.
  • Fill in the Blanks: Use the provided list of keywords to complete the sentences in your notebook, successfully reconstructing the narrative of the event.

Key Features

  • Diverse Scenarios: Explore a wide variety of unique situations, strange anomalies, and intricate puzzles that go far beyond standard crime scenes.
  • Pure Deductive Logic: With the keywords already provided, your success depends entirely on your ability to observe, reason, and make connections.
  • Interactive Thinking Grid: Slot the correct words into your notebook to answer the crucial questions of who, what, how, and why.
  • Play at Your Own Pace: There are no timers or quick-time events. Take your time to study the details, formulate your theories, and solve each puzzle at your own speed.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520 / AMD Radeon R5 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon RX 550 / Intel Iris Xe or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
